suphulla.cp: su + past part. of phalati; full flowering, blossoming.
suphulla.p: [ su + phulla (ṇe) + a. Nīti, dhātu. 165. Suphulla-saṃ. ] (ti) Google Translate Well (intellect) open-to-know. (2) Well-opened.

DOP: phulla mfn. , 1. [ ts ] open, in flower; blooming; Abh 542 (~o vikasito); D II 267, 12* (sālaṃ va na ciraṃ ~aṃ pitaraṃ te … namassāmi; Sv 703, 29 foll.: nagaradvāre na ciraṃ pupphito sālo atthi, so ativiya manoharo); S I 81, 14* (padumaṃ yathā … pāto siyā ~am avītagandhaṃ) = A III 239, 24* ; Vv 6:7 (uddālakā pāṭaliyo ca ~ā); Th 528 (dumāni ~āni manoramāni); Ja VI 452, 18* (~aṃ disvāna kiṃsukaṃ); 534, 31* (padumā ~ā); Th-a II 224, 5 (°-ttā eva sabbā disā pavanti); — 2. [ BHS id. ] (what is) split, broken; mouldy; Sp 1221, 21 (khaṇḍan ti bhinnokāso, ~an ti phalitokāso); 1224, 7 (chadanabhittibhūmīsu yaṃ kiñci khaṇḍaṃ vā ~aṃ vā hoti); Ap-a 465, 22 foll. (~an ti kaṭṭhānaṃ jiṇṇaṭṭhāne kaṇṇakitamahicchattakādipupphanaṃ, khaṇḍaṃ ca ~aṃ ca khaṇḍaphullāni); Sadd 436, 14 foll. (phulla vikasanabhedesu: … khaṇḍaphullapaṭisaṅkharaṇaṃ); — ifc see khaṇḍa-; — phullāni in Ee at Ja IV 429, 2* is wr for thullāni ( Ce so ) or thūlāni ( Be, Se so ); — phullapaccena in Ee at Ap 586, 2 is prob. wr; Be, Ce, Se phullapaddhena; — suphulla , mfn. , full of flowers; abundantly or beautifully in bloom; Vv 41:2 (paduminiyo ~ā); Ja V 168, 26* ; 203, 18* (vanaṃ yathā aggagimhe ~aṃ, so read with Be, Ce, Se ); Ap 50, 11 (~aṃ padumaṃ gayha); Bv 7:25 (~aṃ pavanaṃ); — see also phalati 1 , phāliphulla, mukhaphulla ( sv mukha ).

suphussita.p: [ su + phussa + ta. Phussa-dhāta pākatadhāna၌rhisañña. ] (ti) Google Translate Well-seeing-perceived-acquired.

pn: Suphassā 01. A female crow, wife of Supatta. She is identified with Rāhulamātā. Ja.ii.436.
Suphassā 03. A celestial musician or a musical instrument. Vv-a.94.
